summary: Beyond Air, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a securities purchase agreement for a private placement of common stock, pre-funded warrants, and Series A/B warrants. The offering of 167,011 shares and 1,638,835 pre-funded warrants, each with accompanying warrants, was priced at $5.66 per unit for institutional investors and $5.76 for directors/officers, expected gross proceeds of approximately $10.2 million. Proceeds are for working capital. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural special-situation elements are present. What to watch: warrant exercise and dilution impact.
